stem.text: Organism X produces molecule Y, which blocks the activity of 70S ribosomes.
An experiment was carried out to investigate the effect of Y on bacterial cells.
An agar plate with bacteria growing all over its surface had four wells cut into the agar. Different substances were added to each well and the agar plate with bacteria was incubated for a week.
The diagram shows the results after a week.

stem.alt: Circular agar plate filled with bacterial growth, with four labelled wells: intact cells of organism X, sterile distilled water only, concentrated solution made from the cytoplasm of lots of organism X cells, and commonly used antibiotic; the two larger wells are marked no bacterial growth.

stem.text: Which conclusions can be made from these results?

columns: molecule Y functions as an antibiotic
molecule Y cannot be released from cells of organism X
molecule Y would also affect the synthesis of proteins from nuclear DNA in a human cell
